packageRules.description: No cooldown for images: Docker Hub dates a tag by its last push, not its release, and some tags have no date, which the cooldown would hold forever
Docker Hub tags Fedora Rawhide with the next release number, so approve each new Fedora release on the dependency dashboard once it is out
One PR for the crate updates that semver says are compatible; breaking ones get their own
One PR for the compatible web UI package updates; breaking ones get their own
tonic and prost: tonic's codegen and runtime need the matching prost
OpenTelemetry: tracing-opentelemetry (its own repo) pins the opentelemetry release it bridges to
RustCrypto: hmac and sha2 must share a digest release for Hmac<Sha256>
rtnetlink re-exports the netlink-packet-* releases it is built on
sqlx and the sqlx-cli CI builds (SQLX_CLI_VERSION in rust-ci.yml) for the offline query cache
Cloud Hypervisor: the SDK's tag (qarax-node/Cargo.toml) and the release it serializes (versions/cloud-hypervisor-version) move together, in one PR for the newest release
Firecracker: the SDK's tag (qarax-node/Cargo.toml) and the release it serializes (versions/firecracker-version) move together, in one PR for the newest release
Only E2E builds and runs what these pin (node images, hypervisors, node artifacts, the E2E suite), so label their PRs to start it

customManagers.description: The Cloud Hypervisor release, from the SDK tags (vX.Y.0 for vX.Y), so it only moves once the SDK serializes it
The Firecracker release, from the SDK tags (the same as upstream), so it only moves once the SDK serializes it
OverlayBD and the ACI snapshotter: the release under each '# https://github.com/<repo>/releases' comment, and as its digest the build suffix of the release's RPM names
The guest kernel: Cloud Hypervisor tags its builds ch-release-v<kernel>-<date>

github-rpm-release.description: A GitHub repository's releases, with the build suffix of their x86_64 RPM names (<name>-<version>-<suffix>.[<dist>.]x86_64.rpm) as the digest
transformTemplates: {"releases": [$[prerelease = false and draft = false and $count(assets[$contains(name, ".x86_64.rpm")]) > 0].{"version": $replace(tag_name, /^v/, ""), "releaseTimestamp": published_at, "digest": $match(assets[$contains(name, ".x86_64.rpm")][0].name, /^[a-z-]+-[0-9.]+-([0-9]+\.[0-9a-f]+)\./).groups[0]}], "sourceUrl": $substringBefore($[0].html_url, "/releases/")}
